t: Quick-drying, non-conductive spray. Easily cleans oil, dirt, flux residue and condensation from sensitive electronics and electrical equipment. Improves electrical contact in cars in damp conditions. Simply spray on and allow the product to dry before powering up. Rapidly penetrates into hard to reach areas to remove all the contaminants that cause current leakage and component failure. Ideal for use on circuit boards, switches, spark plugs and tape heads. Safe to use for cleaning plastics, rubber and metal. Because it contains PTFE, it sticks to the surface, repels water and withstands temperatures of -20°C to 100°C. Keeps tools and machinery working smoothly. Improves the life of garden tools and car parts. Protects against rust and corrosion. Sprays on easily with a protective coating for auto hinges, gears, sprockets, winches and chains, latches, door tracks, pulleys, cables, tow bars and guide rails. Flip straw down for spray or up for a precise, narrow spray. 360° valve allows for upright or upside-down application.
b: Use on Electrical Equipment, Contacts, Plastics & Rubber
Smart Straw System for Direct Application
